Hi again! 🌿 Great question.

The duplicate-avoidance option is part of Plant Club, and it works the same way on both plans:

- You can list **up to 3 plants you already own** so we can avoid sending duplicates.
- You can't choose the specific plant, since each box is a surprise.

What I can't confirm is whether the list you've already set up carries over automatically when you change plans. Our knowledge base doesn't cover that detail, so I don't want to guess.

To be safe:

- **After you upgrade today (the 22nd):** Check your subscription settings under Account > Subscriptions and make sure your 3 plants are still listed. Do this **before the 25th**, when your next box is billed.
- **If you'd like a definite answer first:** I can escalate this to a Support Lead so you get confirmation before you upgrade.

Would you like me to escalate it? Thanks for being a Leafy plant parent! 🪴
